narrative: TR-B05-R084 was squealing on the east sweep, same as the others on that block have been doing, the old grease had separated out and gone hard so I cleaned it all out and repacked it properly. These older rows are all about due for it, that is four now off this block this quarter, and I would say the rest of them want doing before they start making the same noise rather than us going out one at a time as they do.
